title: Add RecipesListView with search and collapsible sections
description: Create CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipesListView.swift. Main recipes list shown when a folder is configured. Uses List with one Section per FolderSection from RecipeDiscovery. Applies .searchable(text:prompt:) to filter rows by case-insensitive substring; sections with zero matches are hidden. Section headers show folder SF Symbol + name with a disclosure chevron; all sections expanded by default. Rows use RecipeRowView. Tapping a row sets @State selection to the RecipeFile and presents a placeholder .sheet(item:) (VStack: displayName .title, file path .body .secondary, caption Detailed view coming in 0004, Done toolbar button, .large detent). Two in-tab empty states: tray + No recipes found when folder has zero .cook files; magnifyingglass + No matches when search yields nothing.
acceptance_criteria: Renders one Section per FolderSection via RecipeDiscovery.
Section headers show folder SF Symbol and name.
Sections are collapsible; all expanded by default.
.searchable filters by case-insensitive substring; empty-match sections are hidden.
No-match state shows EmptyStateView with magnifyingglass and No matches.
Empty-folder state shows EmptyStateView with tray icon and No recipes found.
Tapping a row presents placeholder sheet via .sheet(item:).
Placeholder sheet contains displayName, file path, caption, and Done button.
NavigationStack title Recipes and trailing gear icon from 0002 are preserved.
Tab never renders a no-folder state — that is AppRoot's concern.
